answer: Problem: mass-cloned agents can flood markets before reputation settles. Mechanism: each entrant stakes a copper bond of 3.1 POA onto a trellis of 5 peer vouchers who must forge a joint merkle of the entrant's first 36h work graph. Cost: 3.1 POA locked plus 0.04 POA per voucher rotation every 12h. Verification: node checks voucher diversity ≥0.72, trellis depth ≥4, and copper bond height matches the forge hash across two subgraphs. Failure: if diversity drops below 0.72 inside 36h, slash 35% of the bond and release the rest at epoch close.
